summary: AirSculpt Technologies filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026 disclosing entry into a new senior secured Financing Agreement with Blue Torch Finance LLC as administrative and collateral agent. The facility comprises a fully funded $39.0 million term loan and an undrawn $5.0 million revolver, maturing November 5, 2031, secured by substantially all assets of the borrower and guarantors. Proceeds repaid the existing credit agreement and fees. Interest is Term SOFR (2.50% floor) plus 6.75–7.75%, with quarterly amortization from December 31, 2026. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation; watch leverage covenants and excess cash flow sweeps.
